metadata.question: Was the vegetation health (NDVI) in Namibia worse in February 21-28 2019, compared to the long-term average for the same month period from 2003 to 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Dataset: MODIS Terra MOD13A1 v061 (500 m, 16-day NDVI). Fallback to Aqua MYD13A1 if needed.
   - Location: Namibia from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017.
   - Time: Target window 2019-02-21 to 2019-03-01 (end exclusive). Baseline per-year windows 2003–2017 for the same dates. If empty, widen to Feb 15–Mar 06.
2. Masking strategy:
   - Use SummaryQA (0=good). If zero valid pixels, relax to SummaryQA ≤ 1. Compute NDVI = NDVI * 0.0001.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - Check collection sizes first (C1).
   - Check valid pixel counts after masking (C2).
   - Check NDVI means for null/NaN/out-of-range [-0.2, 1] (C3).
   - Compare NDVI2019 vs baseline mean; lower means “worse” (A), else (B).
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((v, e) => {
      if (e) reject(e);
      else resolve(v);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const country = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia'))
      .geometry();
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e13;

    const tgtStart = ee.Date('2019-02-21');
    const tgtEnd = ee.Date('2019-03-01');
    const tgtStartWide = ee.Date('2019-02-15');
    const tgtEndWide = ee.Date('2019-03-06');

    const baseYears = ee.List.sequence(2003, 2017);
    const baseStartMonth = 2, baseStartDay = 21;
    const baseEndMonth = 3, baseEndDay = 1;
    const baseStartMonthWide = 2, baseStartDayWide = 15;
    const baseEndMonthWide = 3, baseEndDayWide = 6;

    // 2. Helpers
    const terra = 'MODIS/061/MOD13A1';
    const aqua = 'MODIS/061/MYD13A1';

    function prepNDVI(ic, qaMax) {
      return ee.ImageCollection(ic).map(function(img) {
        const ndvi = img.select('NDVI').multiply(0.0001).rename('NDVI');
        const qa = img.select('SummaryQA');
        const mask = qa.lte(qaMax);
        return ndvi.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
      });
    }

    function yearWindowCollection(ic, years, m1, d1, m2, d2) {
      const merged = ee.ImageCollection(ee.List(years).iterate(function(y, acc) {
        y = ee.Number(y);
        const part = ee.ImageCollection(ic).filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(y, m1, d1), ee.Date.fromYMD(y, m2, d2));
        return ee.ImageCollection(acc).merge(part);
      }, ee.ImageCollection([])));
      return merged;
    }

    async function buildTarget(qaMax) {
      let src = terra, usedWindow = 'Narrow';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterDate(tgtStart, tgtEnd);
      let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        // Try Aqua same window
        src = aqua;
        col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterDate(tgtStart, tgtEnd);
        size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (size === 0) {
          // Widen Terra
          src = terra; usedWindow = 'Wide';
          col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterDate(tgtStartWide, tgtEndWide);
          size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
          if (size === 0) {
            // Widen Aqua
            src = aqua;
            col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterDate(tgtStartWide, tgtEndWide);
            size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
            if (size === 0) {
              return {status: 'C1'};
            }
          }
        }
      }
      const ndviCol = prepNDVI(col, qaMax);
      const img = ndviCol.median().clip(country);
      return {status: 'OK', img, src, usedWindow, size};
    }

    async function buildBaseline(qaMax) {
      let src = terra, usedWindow = 'Narrow';
      let baseColRaw = yearWindowCollection(ee.ImageCollection(src), baseYears, baseStartMonth, baseStartDay, baseEndMonth, baseEndDay);
      let size = await getInfoAsync(baseColRaw.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        // Aqua narrow
        src = aqua;
        baseColRaw = yearWindowCollection(ee.ImageCollection(src), baseYears, baseStartMonth, baseStartDay, baseEndMonth, baseEndDay);
        size = await getInfoAsync(baseColRaw.size());
        if (size === 0) {
          // Terra wide
          src = terra; usedWindow = 'Wide';
          baseColRaw = yearWindowCollection(ee.ImageCollection(src), baseYears, baseStartMonthWide, baseStartDayWide, baseEndMonthWide, baseEndDayWide);
          size = await getInfoAsync(baseColRaw.size());
          if (size === 0) {
            // Aqua wide
            src = aqua;
            baseColRaw = yearWindowCollection(ee.ImageCollection(src), baseYears, baseStartMonthWide, baseStartDayWide, baseEndMonthWide, baseEndDayWide);
            size = await getInfoAsync(baseColRaw.size());
            if (size === 0) {
              return {status: 'C1'};
            }
          }
        }
      }
      const ndviCol = prepNDVI(baseColRaw, qaMax);
      const img = ndviCol.mean().clip(country); // per-pixel mean baseline over years
      return {status: 'OK', img, src, usedWindow, size};
    }

    async function pixelStats(img) {
      const validCount = await getInfoAsync(img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: country,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('NDVI'));
      const totalCount = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image(1).rename('NDVI').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: country,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('NDVI'));
      return {validCount: validCount || 0, totalCount: totalCount || 0, validPct: (validCount && totalCount) ? (100.0 * validCount / totalCount) : 0};
    }

    async function regionMean(img) {
      const mean = await getInfoAsync(img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: country,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('NDVI'));
      return mean;
    }

    // 3. Target build with QA strict, fallback if needed
    let tgt = await buildTarget(0);
    if (tgt.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('Target: No images in any window/source.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    let tgtStats = await pixelStats(tgt.img);
    if (tgtStats.validCount === 0) {
      // Relax QA
      tgt = await buildTarget(1);
      if (tgt.status === 'C1') {
        console.log('Target: No images in any window/source.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      tgtStats = await pixelStats(tgt.img);
      if (tgtStats.validCount === 0) {
        console.log('Target: 0 valid pixels after masking.');
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 4. Baseline build with QA strict, fallback if needed
    let base = await buildBaseline(0);
    if (base.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('Baseline: No images in any window/source.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    let baseStats = await pixelStats(base.img);
    if (baseStats.validCount === 0) {
      // Relax QA
      base = await buildBaseline(1);
      if (base.status === 'C1') {
        console.log('Baseline: No images in any window/source.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      baseStats = await pixelStats(base.img);
      if (baseStats.validCount === 0) {
        console.log('Baseline: 0 valid pixels after masking.');
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 5. Calculation
    const ndvi2019 = await regionMean(tgt.img);
    const ndviBase = await regionMean(base.img);

    // 6. Validation & Output
    const sizestrT = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(tgt.size));
    const sizestrB = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(base.size));

    console.log(`Target window: ${await getInfoAsync(tgt.usedWindow)} | Source: ${await getInfoAsync(tgt.src)} | Images: ${sizestrT}`);
    console.log(`Target valid px: ${tgtStats.validCount} / ${tgtStats.totalCount} (${tgtStats.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    console.log(`Baseline years: 2003-2017 | Window: ${await getInfoAsync(base.usedWindow)} | Source: ${await getInfoAsync(base.src)} | Images: ${sizestrB}`);
    console.log(`Baseline valid px: ${baseStats.validCount} / ${baseStats.totalCount} (${baseStats.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    if (ndvi2019 === null || ndviBase === null || isNaN(ndvi2019) || isNaN(ndviBase) ||
        ndvi2019 < -0.2 || ndvi2019 > 1.0 || ndviBase < -0.2 || ndviBase > 1.0) {
      console.log(`NDVI2019: ${ndvi2019} | Baseline: ${ndviBase}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = ndvi2019 - ndviBase;
    console.log(`NDVI2019: ${ndvi2019.toFixed(4)} | Baseline: ${ndviBase.toFixed(4)} | Diff: ${diff.toFixed(4)}`);

    if (diff < 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
